name: Instant Replay
author: Anthony Poschen
description: Always-on GPU instant replay for Omarchy: buffer a monitor and save the last N seconds with a hotkey.

barWidget.description: Buffer a monitor and save the last N seconds of gameplay.

schema.label: Monitor
schema.description: Leave empty to capture whichever monitor is focused when the buffer starts.

schema.label: Audio
schema.description: none records video only. desktop is system audio. both mixes system audio and the microphone.

schema.label: Clips folder
schema.description: Where Save writes Clips. Empty uses Videos/Replays.
